answers.answer_text: For waterproof trail running shoes in Singapore, my top pick is the Salomon Speedcross 6 GTX, which offers a waterproof GORE-TEX membrane and deep trail lugs. Another good option is the HOKA Speedgoat 6 GTX. ASICS is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Nike Pegasus 41 because it is a road shoe.
